name: Inotribe
description: Five-page site for Inotribe, a Ghanaian software engineering company that builds mission-critical systems for financial institutions, governments and enterprises. Dark warm-neutral interface with petrol teal and gold, Google Sans and Google Sans Flex, a floating island navbar, pill controls, bento grids and the logo's chevrons framing every label. Home has a glowing dotted world map with an Accra ping, capabilities on fading pills, count-up stats, an animated node graph, case study cards, a CSS tech marquee and client grid. About has a photo collage, mission quote, differentiators, process, a JSON testimonial slider and a capabilities bento. Services has a diagonal case-study bento and capability panel. Work renders four case studies (challenge, what we built, why it matters) from JSON with a live index. Contact posts to Web3Forms. Navbar, footer and a scroll-progress top button are injected once from main.js.
